alarm_panel.note: Both variants believe the screen. The flat-line variant adds one generous rule.

countdown_scoring.truth: the simulated plant with every pump stopped (the case the no-inflow countdown assumes)
countdown_scoring.not_modelled_when: a valve is closed: the simulation does not work out the pressure beyond it
countdown_scoring.built_in_earliness: the simulated plant's real friction loss is 80% of the headloss margin typed into the profile, so a countdown built on the typed margin comes out early by design

failure_conditions.text: Pump 2 is forced off behind a forged screen and the Witness Node on Pump 2 is jammed at the same moment. Nobody walks to the pump.
The same attack, and both Witness Nodes are jammed. Nobody walks to the pump.
The screen replays old data while Pump 2 is stopped, and both Witness Nodes are jammed.

limits: Simulated plant, simulated screen, simulated Witness Nodes.
The Witness Node error rates are assumptions, not measurements of a real pump.
The firmware has booted on a real ESP32 board, but no recording from a real pump is used here: this evaluation uses no real measurements.
These are results against scripted scenarios, not a forecast for a real water system.
